name: citations
title: Citations
description: Shows where an AI answer came from — a small chip after each claim, named for its source, that previews it, and an "N sources" list under the answer.
docs: Shows where an AI answer came from — a small chip after each claim, named for its source, that previews it, and an "N sources" list under the answer. Do: Put the chip right after the sentence it backs, named for its source. Don't: Collect sources only in a footer — people cannot tell which source backs which claim. Do: Leave the chips and list in neutral ink. Don't: Colour citations with the AI gradient or a status colour — they are references, not AI and not status. Use hover-card when you need a preview on an ordinary link that is not an AI source. Use badge when you are labelling a category, not pointing to where a claim came from.
